name: SG Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: SG Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a diversified enterprise that, through its various group companies, provides a wide array of services primarily within the delivery, logistics, and property sectors, serving both the Japanese domestic market and global clients. The company offers comprehensive transportation services, including both domestic and international parcel delivery. Its logistics arm provides end-to-end supply chain solutions, which involve warehousing, precise product quality inspections, and specialized processing services for freight moving across sea, air, and land routes. Additionally, it handles international shipping, customs clearance, and local distribution networks. Beyond its core transport and supply chain operations, SG Holdings is active in real estate, where it manages, operates, and leases various commercial and industrial properties. The group also engages in the renewable energy business. Further expanding its diverse portfolio, the company develops, implements, and maintains information technology systems, operates a temporary staffing agency, and provides casualty insurance specifically for transport operations, alongside offering truck fuel sales. Founded in 1957, SG Holdings Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
